messages:
josh: hitting a weird edge with go-sdk streaming where retries produce malformed JSON for our decoder. happens intermittently under load. error: "json: invalid character ']' after top-level value"

josh: snippet of observed chunks from tcpdump (simplified):
```
chunk1: {"id":"r1","choices":[{"delta":{"text":"Hel"} }
chunk2: "lo" }, {"delta":{"text":" there"}}]
chunk3: {"id":"r2","choices":[{"delta":{"text":"!"}}]
```

josh: our client uses bufio.Scanner split on Bytes then json.Unmarshal on assembled buffer. when the server retries a request, some trailing bytes from previous stream get prepended to the retry stream and the decoder chokes.

marta: thanks, can you confirm which go-sdk version and whether you're using the high-level Stream method or the raw http.Response.Body? also send any retry policy config.

josh: go-sdk v0.9.8, using client.Stream(ctx, req) (high-level). default retry policy (exponential, 2 attempts). no custom framing.

alex: there was a known issue in 0.9.x where the stream scanner didn't treat retry boundaries as stream resets — leads to chunk coalescing into the same token buffer. upgrade to v0.10.1 which changes the stream reader to drop partially-consumed token state on retry. try `go get github.com/redwood/inference-go@v0.10.1` and re-run. :thumbsup:

erin: alternative quick workaround: avoid using bufio.Scanner for assembling JSON frames. Instead read into a bytes.Buffer and use json.Decoder on the incremental reader (Decoder.Decode handles streaming JSON better). e.g.:
```
var br bytes.Buffer
io.CopyN(&br, resp.Body, n) // or read chunks in a loop
dec := json.NewDecoder(&br)
for dec.More() { var msg map[string]interface{}; if err := dec.Decode(&msg); err != nil { log.Println("decode err", err); break } ... }
```

marta: also, if you must keep Scanner, bump the buffer: `scanner.Buffer(make([]byte, 64*1024), 1024*1024)` — but it's only a mitigation, not a fix for cross-retry state.

josh: tested upgrade to v0.10.1 this morning — no more invalid char errors in ~6k requests. latency and throughput same. thanks!

josh: one remaining weirdness: when a proxy in path closes connection mid-stream we get a half-frame then immediate retry; v0.10.1 drops the partial state but app-level logic still sees a stray ']' in logs because our log joiner concatenates raw chunk strings. cleaning up log joiner fixed the last noisy alerts.

marta: great to hear. i'll add a note to the support KB: - recommend v0.10.1+ for streaming stability - prefer json.Decoder over bufio.Scanner for framing - include repro sample for proxy-induced partial frames.

support-bot: linked ticket #INC-4521 created for follow-up docs/KB work.

josh: thanks everyone, closing this thread. :sparkles:
